d: Paraguay's Ueno Bank crisis has plunged millions of customers into uncertainty, triggered investigations into hundreds of millions of dollars in public deposits, and sparked an impeachment battle threatening President Santiago Peña's political future. Once one of the country's fastest-growing digital banks, Ueno was placed under central bank intervention after its solvency ratio fell below regulatory requirements.
